{{DISPLAYTITLE:Salikawood (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:TASalikawood.png|right|thumb|250px|Tricky Spirits in Salikawood.]]
{{Quote|The chirping of birds can always be heard here. An abandoned keep stands in the middle of the wood.|Description}}
'''Salikawood''' {{J|サリカ樹林|Sarika jurin}} is the woodland location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. The first fight with [[Babus Swain]] in "Mission #010: Emerald Keep" occurs here. Rumors of a giant emerald [[Crystal (term)|crystal]] bring Babus and [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] to the same location in the wood, where Marche lets slip that he knows [[Mewt Randell|Prince Mewt]] and Babus attempted to apprehend him. It can be freed in "Mission #248: The Salikawood" after "Mission #012: Jagd Hunt" is completed.

==Missions==
*"Mission #010: Emerald Keep"
{{Quote|The Royal Mage Academy has given up their research for the giant emerald crystal of Salika Keep. Treasure hunters, now's your chance!|Levey, Search Team Member}}
*"Mission #035: Salika Keep"
{{Quote|Gaol, lover of the moon maiden Evelyn, was out with Lini the Moogle when the keeplord of Salika invited them... to die!|"The Hero Gaol, Chapter 4"}}
*"Mission #081: The Redwings"
{{Quote|The Redwings base has been found in the Salikawood. Dark Knight Grissom, the Redwings boss is there. Godspeed.|The Mysterious Minstrel}}
*"Mission #093: Flan Breakout"
{{Quote|There's been an outbreak of flan near our logging site! They'll eat all the trees, and we'll be out of a job! Help!|Dals, Lumberjack}}
*"Mission #248: The Salikawood"
{{Quote|I plan on cutting a path though the Salikawood. I'll do some reforesting, too! I can't pay much, but I really need help.|Laycher, Innkeeper}}
